projects.name: BikeRide Driver App
projects.tech_stack: Flutter, Firebase (Firestore + Realtime DB + Auth + FCM + Storage), GetX, Google Maps, Node.js Cloud Functions
projects.context: BikeRide is an inDrive-style motorcycle ride and delivery platform for Egypt. Driver app is Flutter (Android/iOS). Full Firebase architecture — no Laravel API. GetX for state/routing/DI. Bidding system where drivers counter-bid on customer trip requests. All wallet writes go through Cloud Functions only. Background GPS writes directly to Realtime DB every 3 seconds. Bilingual Arabic/English with RTL support.

tasks.title: Fix onboarding persistence bug — app-type-specific SharedPreferences key
tasks.description: OnboardingController uses a single SharedPreferences key 'onboarding_completed' shared across customer and driver apps. This means completing customer onboarding also skips driver onboarding. Fix by using app-type-specific keys.
acceptance_criteria: OnboardingController saves key as 'onboarding_completed_driver' in driver app (main_driver.dart sets appType = 'driver')
OnboardingController saves key as 'onboarding_completed_customer' in customer app
SplashController reads the app-type-specific key, not a shared key
Completing customer onboarding does NOT skip driver onboarding
Key persists correctly across app restarts
